messages.subject: Questions on Use Cases
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

Is it appropriate to use Garnett to separate cells that are highly expressing gene X and lowly expressing gene Y, inverse, or highly expressing both? The ability to integrate other gene features and create its own expression thresholds based on the data seems preferential over a boolean subsetting.

How much stock do you put into the ambiguity warning?

Best,
Olaf

messages.subject: Garnett Use Case Questions
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I have a few questions about the use cases for Garnett:
* What is the minimum cell sample size?
* Can you still get meaningful data out of ambiguous markers?
* Can you use Garnett to divide a cell population on expression of only 2 genes (expression of X and Y, expression of only X, expression of only Y, expression of neither)? It would be convenient to have Garnett set the threshold between low and high expression.

Best,
Olaf
